note: 卡在洞口出不来的软泥怪,被玩家打出来后送礼物,最后一句是「我的另一半原本真的是我的一半」的冷笑话。

messages.text: Hey you! Help me I'm stuck!
messages.zh: 喂,那边的! 救救我,我卡住了!

messages.raw: §fI fell asleep and when I woke up I was too large to fit the entrance!
messages.text: I fell asleep and when I woke up I was too large to fit the entrance!
messages.zh: 我睡了一觉,醒来就发现自己胖得从入口钻不出去了!

messages.text: Maybe you can punch me out.
messages.zh: 要不你把我打出去试试。

messages.raw: §fThank you so much, I stayed there for weeks!
messages.text: Thank you so much, I stayed there for weeks!
messages.zh: 太感谢你了,我在那儿卡了好几个星期!

messages.raw: §fYou freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!
messages.text: You freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!
messages.zh: 你不但把我放了出来,还帮我找到了此生挚爱!
拿着这份心意,算是我的回礼!

messages.raw: §fMaybe I feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?
messages.text: Maybe I feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?
messages.zh: 也许我和我的另一半之间感应这么强烈,是因为——它本来就真的是我的另一半?
